summary: Iteration 10 — verified MongoDB-backed image storage, DELETE /api/admin/products/bulk, GET /api/admin/tags aggregation, POST /api/admin/tags/oos set+clear, and full frontend E2E tags/OOS flow. 9/9 pytest cases pass. Frontend admin flow: bulk-delete-btn, tag-oos-panel, tag-input, tag-add-btn, tag-chip/tag-remove, tag-pill, tag-oos-select, tag-oos-until, tag-oos-apply, tag-clear all functional. Réactiver toast + confirm accepted successfully.

integration_issues.issue: TagOOSPanel does not auto-refresh when a product is saved from the ProductEditor. The tag list only re-fetches on mount or after its own apply/clearTag. User must manually reload the page to see newly added tags. Manifests as: after adding 'e2etag' to a product and saving, the pill/dropdown remain empty until the page is reloaded.

action_items: Consider making TagOOSPanel re-fetch /api/admin/tags when parent MenuTab.load() runs after a product save. Simplest fix: pass a `refreshKey` prop that changes on save and re-runs the useEffect, or lift tags state to the parent. Currently users must reload the page to see newly added/removed tags in the panel.

Server-side: the `existing epicerie products` schema restore requires image_url as string (not null). Product model in server.py accepts image_url: str = '' but rejects null — consider Optional[str] for defensive imports.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — 911 lines; still above 700 threshold. Split by domain (products, uploads, admin/tags, orders).
storage.py — clean, portable, MongoDB-backed. No external dependency. Correct fallback in serve_upload for legacy on-disk files.
Admin.jsx — 1445 lines, heavy monolith. TagOOSPanel + ProductEditor + MenuTab live in same file; consider extracting into /components/admin/.
TagOOSPanel: no auto-refresh on external product changes (integration gap listed above).
